I'm hiring "Agentic AI Developer Intern (Python)" at Omnuvex

I'm looking for someone to join my team and own the AI agent product line we're building — RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, CRM integrations, multi-step agentic workflows. Real systems, real clients, production from day one.

Here's what matters to me more than your stack:
You learn fast. You pick up a new framework in days, not weeks. Docs, AI tools, trial-and-error — you figure it out. You don't wait to be taught.

You think long-term. You're not here for a line on your CV. You want to grow into someone who designs and builds AI systems independently — and you're willing to put in the work to get there.

You ship. A working v1 today beats a perfect plan next week. You're comfortable with ambiguity, incomplete specs, and shifting priorities. You adapt and deliver.

You own your work. No one chases you for updates. You treat every task like it's your product.

On the technical side — Python, understanding of LLMs and RAG, REST API experience, and daily use of AI dev tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot). LangChain, FastAPI, Redis, Docker are a plus but not a dealbreaker if everything above checks out.

What you get: → Paid internship with performance-based conversion to full-time → Production work from week one — not slides, not busywork → Clear growth path to AI Systems Developer → Promotion based on output, not time served
